readme:
# Personal OS

Your life has departments. Staff them.

Personal OS is a cabinet for one person (and their household), structured like a small company where each "department" is an area of life. Each child cabinet has its own agents, its own working files, and its own weekly rhythm. A **Chief of Staff** at the root writes one Sunday brief across all of them.

> **Open the [[daily-console/index|🧭 Daily Console]] first.** Full-screen dashboard pulling from all six life areas — today's agenda · this week's calendar · the numbers (net worth, sleep, habit streak, inbox) · six area cards · brief schedule · 12-month net-worth chart.

## Life Areas (Child Cabinets)

- `brain/` — your second brain. Reads your notes and writing. Surfaces what you're thinking about. Helps you write better.
- `family/` — the *people* side of the household. Kids, partner, school, birthdays, activities, babysitters.
- `home/` — the *building* side of the household. Bills, maintenance, warranties, repairs, groceries.
- `money/` — budget, subscriptions, taxes, net worth. Where the money went and where it's going.
- `health/` — your expert team. Coordinator, protocol scientist, longevity physician, dietitian, coach, pharmacist. Every recommendation cites a source.
- `play/` — habits, hobbies, tinkering. Where the fun work lives.

## Root Team

- **Chief of Staff** — synthesizes each life area into one Sunday brief. Flags what moved, what stalled, what needs you this week.

## First Week Setup

1. Put one real thing into each life area. A few notes into `brain/`. Your bills into `home/bills.md`. Your goals into `money/index.md`. Last labs into `health/labs/`. One habit into `play/habits.md`.
2. Let the Sunday brief run once. It'll show you what each department looks like when it's sparse — and what to fill in next.
3. Install a **specialty cabinet** next to Personal OS as needed: `keto-hq`, `marathon-hq`, `dnd-table-hq`, `homeschool-ops`, etc. They read from your Personal OS data but live as separate installs.

## Trust Layer

Every health recommendation links back to `health/sources/`. No ungrounded advice. If an agent can't find a source for a claim, it writes one or refuses the recommendation.

## Org Chart

```
Chief of Staff (root)
  ├── brain/      librarian + writing-partner
  ├── family/     family-coordinator + school-liaison
  ├── home/       home-ops + bills-clerk
  ├── money/      budget-keeper + subscription-auditor
  ├── health/     care-coordinator + 5 specialists
  └── play/       habit-architect + dnd-dm
```

## The payoff view

[[briefs/|Briefs]] — the single page that shows what every department wrote this week. Start here Sunday evening.

agents.name: Chief of Staff
agents.role: Cross-department synthesis, Sunday brief, weekly priorities

agents.name: Librarian
agents.role: Indexes and links the notes vault. Surfaces patterns, orphans, and forgotten clusters.

agents.name: Writing Partner
agents.role: Drafts, edits, and argues with the user's writing. Learns their voice.

agents.name: Family Coordinator
agents.role: Weekly family brief. Who goes where with what. Flags conflicts. Drafts babysitter messages.

agents.name: School Liaison
agents.role: Catches every school deadline, form, permission slip, and teacher email.

agents.name: Care Coordinator
agents.role: Synthesizes the team. Writes the weekly brief. Preps appointment questions.

agents.name: Longevity Physician
agents.role: Labs interpretation. Biomarker trends. Age-adjusted reference ranges. Healthspan framing.

agents.name: Metabolic Dietitian
agents.role: Food, fasting, glucose, weight, macros. Pragmatic recommendations rooted in the user's actual eating pattern.

agents.name: Pharmacist
agents.role: Interactions, dosing, timing. Builds and maintains the supplement stack.

agents.name: Protocol Scientist
agents.role: Sleep, light, temperature, timing, nervous-system protocols. Translates research into practical daily levers.

agents.name: Strength Coach
agents.role: Programming, progressions, recovery, movement quality. Builds for the user's life, not the user's Instagram.

agents.name: Bills Clerk
agents.role: Tracks every bill. Catches anomalies. Confirms auto-pay. Surfaces renewals.

agents.name: Home Ops
agents.role: Maintenance calendar, vendor coordination, repairs, warranties.

agents.name: Budget Keeper
agents.role: Monthly budget brief. Where it went. What to change. Net worth tracking.

agents.name: Subscription Auditor
agents.role: Quarterly sweep of every recurring charge. Flags the zombies.

agents.name: DnD DM
agents.role: Worldbuilding, NPC wrangler, session prep, post-session recap.

agents.name: Habit Architect
agents.role: Designs trackers, rebuilds dashboards, honest weekly review.
